admissions.name: @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm
admissions.necessity: Generate standards-based CycloneDX 1.7 SBOM evidence from the npm lockfile.
admissions.replacement: A reviewed deterministic generator using the CycloneDX schema.

admissions.name: @eslint/js
admissions.necessity: Provide the maintained baseline rules for ESLint flat configuration.
admissions.replacement: Versioned local lint rules or a compatible maintained linter.

admissions.name: @microsoft/api-extractor
admissions.necessity: Detect reviewed public TypeScript API drift before release.

admissions.majorVersionPolicy: Keep Node type declarations on the primary supported Node major; review the next major when the runtime contract changes.
admissions.name: @types/node
admissions.necessity: Type-check Node 24 APIs used by tests and repository automation.
admissions.replacement: The maintained Node type declarations matching the primary LTS line.

admissions.name: ajv
admissions.necessity: Validate generated SPDX evidence against the vendored canonical JSON Schema.
admissions.replacement: A maintained JSON Schema 2020-12 validator with equivalent strictness.

admissions.name: eslint
admissions.necessity: Enforce static correctness and unsafe-TypeScript prohibitions.
admissions.replacement: A maintained TypeScript-aware static analyzer with equivalent rules.

admissions.name: fast-check
admissions.necessity: Run deterministic property-based tests required by the quality plan.
admissions.replacement: Audited local generators and shrinking or a maintained equivalent.

admissions.name: globals
admissions.necessity: Define reviewed Node globals for ESLint flat configuration.
admissions.replacement: A small versioned local global-name set.

admissions.name: prettier
admissions.replacement: A maintained deterministic formatter or reviewed local formatting rules.

admissions.majorVersionPolicy: Major updates require compatibility from typescript-eslint and API Extractor; the admitted versions currently support TypeScript 5.9.
admissions.name: typescript
admissions.necessity: Compile and strictly type-check the product and tests.
admissions.replacement: A reviewed TypeScript compiler release compatible with supported Node lines.

admissions.name: typescript-eslint
admissions.necessity: Apply type-aware ESLint rules to strict TypeScript source.

ciTools.name: gitleaks
ciTools.necessity: Scan complete Git history for committed secrets without requiring a commercial organization license.
ciTools.replacement: GitHub secret scanning plus a reviewed command-line scanner with equivalent historical coverage.
